svg.style: background: #ffffff; background-color: light-dark(#ffffff, #121212); color-scheme: light dark;
svg.content:
<mxfile host="Electron"> <diagram id="practice-executor" name="Running readers' Python safely (executor)"> <mxGraphModel grid="0" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="0" page="0" pageScale="1" pageWidth="827" pageHeight="1169" background="#ffffff" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <mxCell id="title" parent="1" style="text;fontSize=16;fontStyle=1;align=left;" value="Running readers' Python safely (executor)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="30" width="700" x="20" y="10" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="reader" parent="1" style="rounded=1;fillColor=#dae8fc;strokeColor=#6c8ebf;fontSize=13;" value="Reader presses Run
on /python-practice" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="60" width="190" x="20" y="70" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="web" parent="1" style="rounded=1;fillColor=#d5e8d4;strokeColor=#82b366;fontSize=13;fontStyle=1;" value="Website
checks sign-in and limits,
sends code + test INPUTS" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="90" width="220" x="270" y="55" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="api" parent="1" style="rounded=1;fillColor=#e1d5e7;strokeColor=#9673a6;fontSize=13;" value="Executor API
queue, per-user limits,
abuse block" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="80" width="200" x="560" y="60" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="disp" parent="1" style="rounded=1;fillColor=#e1d5e7;strokeColor=#9673a6;fontSize=13;" value="Dispatcher
starts one sandbox per job,
reads result, deletes it" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="80" width="200" x="560" y="210" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="box" parent="1" style="rounded=1;fillColor=#f8cecc;strokeColor=#b85450;fontSize=12;" value="Sandbox (gVisor)
no network, no passwords,
time and memory limits" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="80" width="220" x="850" y="210" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="grade" parent="1" style="rounded=1;fillColor=#d5e8d4;strokeColor=#82b366;fontSize=12;fontStyle=1;" value="Website grades outputs
against expected answers
(never sent to the sandbox)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="80" width="220" x="270" y="210" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="xp" parent="1" style="rounded=1;fillColor=#d5e8d4;strokeColor=#82b366;fontSize=12;fontStyle=1;" value="Progress, XP, badges
(given once)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="55" width="220" x="270" y="350" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e0" edge="1" parent="1" source="reader" style="edgeStyle=none;rounded=0;endArrow=block;endFill=1;strokeColor=#555555;fontSize=11;labelBackgroundColor=#ffffff;" target="web" value=""> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e1" edge="1" parent="1" source="web" style="edgeStyle=none;rounded=0;endArrow=block;endFill=1;strokeColor=#555555;fontSize=11;labelBackgroundColor=#ffffff;" target="api" value="job"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e2" edge="1" parent="1" source="api" style="edgeStyle=none;rounded=0;endArrow=block;endFill=1;strokeColor=#555555;fontSize=11;labelBackgroundColor=#ffffff;" target="disp" value="queued"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e3" edge="1" parent="1" source="disp" style="edgeStyle=none;rounded=0;endArrow=block;endFill=1;strokeColor=#555555;fontSize=11;labelBackgroundColor=#ffffff;" target="box" value="run"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e4" edge="1" parent="1" source="box" style="edgeStyle=none;rounded=0;endArrow=block;endFill=1;strokeColor=#555555;fontSize=11;labelBackgroundColor=#ffffff;dashed=1;" target="disp" value="outputs"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e5" edge="1" parent="1" source="disp" style="edgeStyle=none;rounded=0;endArrow=block;endFill=1;strokeColor=#555555;fontSize=11;labelBackgroundColor=#ffffff;" target="grade" value="result"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e6" edge="1" parent="1" source="grade" style="edgeStyle=none;rounded=0;endArrow=block;endFill=1;strokeColor=#555555;fontSize=11;labelBackgroundColor=#ffffff;" target="xp" value=""> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>
